reason: The conservative reference bootstrap repeatedly invoked sklearn's full ranking sort for every method/seed/draw on the same fixed score vectors; after ten CPU minutes it had produced no final tables or draws.
resolution: Use an exact tie-group weighted AP calculation with precomputed score ranks and frozen synchronized multiplicities; independently compare selected draws 0, 417, and 999 against sklearn average_precision_score. Brier, sensitivity, and FP are direct weighted sums.
